# ex: strict wildcard where types are assignable but not identical
ex {
	type T int
	var x T
	x + 1 -> x + 2
}
-- x.go --
package m

type MyInt int

func F() {
	var x MyInt
	_ = x + 1
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -4,5 +4,5 @@

 func F() {
 	var x MyInt
-	_ = x + 1
+	_ = x + 2
 }
